nodes.question: What types of enzymes were found in the genomes of halophilic PPB?
nodes.answer: The genes encoded enzymes for ectoine/hydroxyectoine, proline, ubiquinone, and carotenoids such as lycopene, β-carotene, spirilloxanthin, and spheroidene.
nodes.paragraph: Through a compre- hensive literature review, we compiled a list of halo- philic PPB and mined their genomes for genes linked to CO /CO utilization as carbon sources. Further genomic search revealed genes encoding enzymes for ectoine/hydroxyectoine, proline, ubiquinone, and carotenoids (lycopene, -carotene, spirilloxanthin, and spheroidene). We identified 276 genomes of PPB with the genomic potential to valorise CO /CO into health-promoting ingredients, highlighting 22 spe- cies capable of producing three or more chemicals simultaneously. These findings highlight the untapped potential of halophilic PPB as bio-platforms for sus- tainable pharmaceutical production.Supplementary Information The online version contains supplementary material available at https:// doi. org/ 10. 1007/ s11157- 25- 9722-w .
